tokens.name: brand-pink
tokens.usage: Primary brand accent (logo gradient, top) and the CONSORTIUM wordmark, tuned for screen use. The light value is deliberately deeper than the original BLC swatch (#e61077), which was 4.46:1 on light surface and 4.11:1 on surface-raised, under the 4.5:1 text floor; this one is 5.14:1 on surface and 4.73:1 on surface-raised, so it can carry text, links, small button labels, icons, borders and fills at any size. The logo files keep the original artwork colour. The dark-theme value is the CRM's own MudTheme Primary for dark mode, 6.4:1 against dark surfaces.

tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: Secondary brand accent (logo gradient, middle) and the 'Blended Learning' wordmark. Fills, icons and decorative use only, 2.33:1 on light surface, well under the text floor; unchanged in dark mode, the CRM's theme has no dark variant for it. Pair any text on an orange fill with on-orange.

tokens.name: brand-yellow
tokens.usage: Tertiary brand accent (logo gradient, base). Fills and decorative use only, 1.58:1 on light surface; unchanged in dark mode, the CRM's theme has no dark variant for it. Pair any text on a yellow fill with on-yellow.

tokens.name: brand-cyan
tokens.usage: Supporting accent, the confetti detail beside the roundel mark. Fills, chips and small decorative use only, 1.41:1 on light surface, effectively unreadable as text; unchanged in dark mode. Use brand-secondary wherever the cyan family needs to appear as text or an icon.

tokens.name: brand-secondary
tokens.usage: The readable member of the cyan family: a dark teal in light mode, a lighter teal in dark mode, matching the CRM's MudTheme Secondary in both. 7.3:1 on light surface, 7.7:1 on dark surface. Use for text, icons and small status indicators where brand-cyan's meaning is needed but brand-cyan itself can't be read.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on surface and surface-raised. 12.6:1 in light mode; the dark value matches the CRM's MudTheme DrawerText (its only explicit dark text colour), applied here as the general dark text colour, 13.9:1 on dark surface.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary and muted text (captions, metadata, helper text) on surface and surface-raised. 5.7:1 light, 7.4:1 dark. Added scaffolding in both themes, not from a BLC source file.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. The dark value matches the CRM's MudTheme Background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and any surface raised above the page background. The dark value matches the CRM's MudTheme Surface. The CRM also uses a third, slightly different dark shade for its navigation drawer (DrawerBackground, #1a1a2e); left out of this two-tier model for now.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers, input borders and card outlines on surface and surface-raised. Added scaffolding in both themes, chosen to sit quietly within each theme rather than to meet a specific ratio.

tokens.name: on-pink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand-pink fill. 5.14:1 in light mode, so it passes at any size; in dark mode brand-pink is much lighter and surface is dark, so it passes there too (6.4:1).

tokens.name: on-orange
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand-orange fill, 5.42:1. Kept as a fixed dark colour in both themes, since brand-orange itself doesn't change in dark mode.

tokens.name: on-yellow
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand-yellow fill, 7.98:1. Kept as a fixed dark colour in both themes, since brand-yellow itself doesn't change in dark mode.

tokens.name: on-cyan
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand-cyan fill, 8.94:1. Kept as a fixed dark colour in both themes, since brand-cyan itself doesn't change in dark mode.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand-secondary fill, 7.3:1 light, 7.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus outline for keyboard navigation; always solid, at least 2px. 5.14:1 against light surface, 4.73:1 against surface-raised, 6.4:1 against dark surfaces.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Validation errors in data grids and forms: the cell or field outline, the error icon and the error sentence. 6.5:1 on light surface and 6.0:1 on surface-raised; 8.1:1 on dark surface and 7.2:1 on surface-raised. Added for data entry, not taken from a BLC source. It is close to brand-pink in lightness (1.3:1), so always show an error with an icon and a sentence, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Background of a cell or field that has an error. Text on it: ink (11:1 light, 11.8:1 dark) and danger (5.7:1 light, 6.8:1 dark).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page and hero titles, the largest style in the system.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: Secondary hero or page subtitle set beneath a Title.

styles.name: section-header
styles.usage: Small in-page section labels above a group of content.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Pull-quotes and testimonials. Not yet set in the BLC font panel this system was built from; inferred from Body at a larger italic size, confirm before treating as final.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Image captions, footnotes and metadata. Not yet set in the BLC font panel this system was built from; inferred as a smaller Body, confirm before treating as final.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: icon-to-label, chip padding. Added scaffolding, not in the BLC brand file.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Compact padding: small buttons, list-item gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Default padding for compact controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default padding and gap: cards, form fields, standard stacks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Separation between components within a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding; page gutters on mobile.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Major section breaks; page gutters on desktop.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for any interactive control, in both directions (WCAG 2.5.5). Pad with space-2 or space-3 rather than shrinking the control itself.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, small controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, standard containers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels, modals, hero cards.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills and avatars; echoes the roundel mark's circular badge.
